Both locations

Infrared sauna

Gentle infrared warmth for a slower moment in your day.

Benefits & considerations

Warmth, less tension & a slower mind. Clearlight infrared warmth offers a place to leave the day behind. People choose sauna time to unwind, soften the feeling of everyday tension, and settle into a calmer evening.

Make it your moment. A quiet break after work, some time to yourself, or part of a regular wind-down ritual. Let the warmth set a slower pace.

Both locations

Cold plunge

A cool-water immersion experience, on its own or alongside warmth.

Benefits & considerations

A mental reset & a refreshed outlook. Cold plunging is often chosen for the invigorating, clear-headed feeling afterward. The Coldtub experience invites you to be present, step out of mental autopilot, and enjoy a fresh sense of alertness.

Make it your moment. Whether your day has been busy, stressful, or simply ordinary, a comfortable cold-water pause can feel like a change of channel. Keep it brief and follow the studio guidance.

Both locations

Normatec compression

Rhythmic air compression around your legs while you recline.

Benefits & considerations

Lighter-feeling legs & everyday comfort. Normatec’s rhythmic air compression encourages circulation and offers a soothing squeeze-and-release massage. People reach for it after hours at a desk, a long drive, travel, or a day on their feet.

Make it your moment. Recline and let your legs have a break. In Framingham, add guided meditation for a little mental downtime, too.

Framingham

BrainTap meditation

Guided audio and a light-and-sound headset for a focused pause.

Benefits & considerations

Less mental noise. More space for you.. BrainTap brings guided audio, light, and sound together in an immersive pause. Its programs focus on relaxation, mental clarity, focus, and winding down for sleep—helpful intentions for anyone navigating a full life.

Make it your moment. Choose a program to match your day: decompress after work, step away from screens, or make room for a calmer state of mind. No meditation experience needed.

Framingham

Salt chamber

A quiet salt-lined setting for time away from the everyday.

Benefits & considerations

Respiratory comfort & room to exhale. SALT Chamber’s dry salt therapy centers on fine salt particles in a restful environment. People explore it with breathing comfort and respiratory wellness in mind, while enjoying a peaceful escape from everyday dust, noise, and busyness.

Make it your moment. Settle in, let your shoulders drop, and enjoy the salt-air atmosphere. A quiet moment for yourself is reason enough to visit.

Framingham

Eucalyptus steam room

Moist warmth with eucalyptus, as part of your Framingham visit.

Benefits & considerations

Soothing warmth & a sensory refresh. Humid warmth and eucalyptus create a cocoon-like escape from the day. People enjoy the enveloping heat, the fresh aroma, and the feeling of letting go of everyday tension.

Make it your moment. Take an unhurried pause, enjoy the change in atmosphere, and let this be a comforting part of your own spa ritual.

Framingham

Warm-water hydrotherapy

Settle into the warm water of our Framingham hot tub.

Benefits & considerations

Feel supported. Let the day soften.. Warm water and buoyancy create a feeling of lightness and ease. A soak can be a comforting way to unwind, take the weight off your feet, and enjoy a little space away from everyday demands.

Make it your moment. Come for a quiet solo pause or a relaxed moment with someone you care about. An ordinary day is reason enough to enjoy the water.

Framingham

BioCharger

A seated light-and-frequency experience in a dedicated space.

Benefits & considerations

Energy, clarity & a different kind of reset. BioCharger’s light-and-frequency programs are built around wellness themes such as relaxation, everyday energy, and mental clarity. For people curious about holistic wellness and biohacking, it offers a distinctive way to pause and explore how they feel.

Make it your moment. Ask the team about a program that matches your intention—winding down, taking a midday break, or adding something new to your self-care routine.

Framingham · Premium

PEMF therapy

A separate appointment using pulsed electromagnetic field equipment.

Benefits & considerations

Everyday comfort & moving with more ease. People explore Pulse PEMF as part of a wellness routine focused on comfort, relaxation, and easier movement. From desk-day stiffness to the wear and tear of a full schedule, the intention is to make room for your body.

Make it your moment. Rest during a dedicated session and let the team help you get comfortable with the pulsing sensation. Book it on its own or add it to your Framingham day pass.

Framingham · Premium

Flowpresso

Full-body compression, gentle warmth, and deep pressure in a dedicated appointment.

Benefits & considerations

Unwind deeply & make room for rest. Flowpresso combines full-body compression, warmth, and deep pressure in an enveloping sensory experience. People choose it to ease the feeling of built-up tension, switch out of a busy mindset, and make relaxation and restful evenings a priority.

Make it your moment. For anyone carrying a long to-do list, a demanding week, or simply a need for quiet. Let yourself feel supported without having to do anything.

Westwood

Red light therapy

Red and near-infrared light in the Westwood Recovery Room.

Benefits & considerations

Skin-focused self-care & a gentle pause. Red and near-infrared light are popular in routines centered on skin appearance and everyday wellness. Some targeted light treatments may improve the look of fine lines with repeated use; the experience can also be a simple, quiet addition to your self-care time.

Make it your moment. Enjoy a light-focused pause in Westwood at your own pace. Follow the studio’s guidance for the panel and make it part of the visit that feels right for you.

Choose what feels right for you. Experiences and results vary. If you are pregnant, have a heart or circulation condition, an implanted electronic device, or sensitivity to heat, cold, or flashing light, check with your healthcare professional before visiting and let us know. Our team can review the relevant studio guidance with you. Medical disclaimer (PDF) ↗
